title: Handling loose impediments
question: There are leaves and twigs right next to your ball on the fairway. What are your options?

choices.text: Remove the leaves and twigs without penalty, as long as you don't move the ball.
If your ball moves while removing them, put it back and take a 1-stroke penalty.
Ignore the leaves and twigs and play your shot as it is.
Clean your ball before playing, even if you haven't marked it.

explanation: You can remove loose impediments like leaves and twigs, but if your ball moves while doing so you must replace it and take a 1-stroke penalty. You can also just choose to play as it lies.
